unauthenticated.title: Please sign in
unauthenticated.body: This page needs an account. Sign in and we will bring you straight back.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this
forbidden.body: Your account is signed in, but it is not allowed to open this page.

notFound.title: We could not find that page
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the opportunity may have been taken down.

opportunityNotFound.title: This opportunity is no longer listed
opportunityNotFound.body: It may have closed or been removed. Here is what is open right now.

conflict.title: You have already applied
conflict.body: You can only apply once to an opportunity. Open your application to see its status.

validation.title: Check your answers
validation.body: Some fields need attention before this can be sent.

network.title: We could not reach the server
network.body: Check your connection and try again. Nothing you typed has been lost.

server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.body: This has been logged. Trying again often works.

notConfigured.title: This feature is not connected yet
notConfigured.body: The backend service for this part of YVC is not configured in this deployment.

boundary.title: This page could not be displayed
boundary.body: An unexpected error stopped this page from rendering.
